mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sal_chance WHERE chc_cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR chc_linkman LIKE CONCAT('%', #{contactPerson}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sal_chance (chc_cust_name, chc_source, chc_rate, chc_linkman, chc_tel, chc_title, chc_desc, chc_create_by, chc_create_date) VALUES (#{chcCustName}, #{chcSource}, #{chcRate}, #{chcLinkman}, #{chcTel}, #{chcTitle}, #{chcDesc}, #{chcCreateBy}, #{chcCreateDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE sal_chance SET chc_source = #{salChance.chcSource}, chc_rate = #{salChance.chcRate}, chc_linkman = #{salChance.chcLinkman}, chc_tel = #{salChance.chcTel}, chc_title = #{salChance.chcTitle}, chc_desc = #{salChance.chcDesc}, chc_cust_name = #{salChance.chcCustName} WHERE chc_id = #{id}
